integrity: One positive-mass theorem with exact nodal-kernel proof and standard-library rational checker; prior atom-free formula acknowledged, with no claim of independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite stars with constant positive edge densities and exactly one strictly positive central atom; no arbitrary trees, variable densities, interior atoms, or higher-degree elements. Stronger equivalent antecedents in unindexed literature and full Boman (2006) comparison remain unresolved.
title: Sharp mixed-measure affine projection on metric stars: atomic-mass thresholds and vanishing-arm instability
